topics.label: Course introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the administrative welcome and outlines the core learning objectives of the lecture series.

topics.label: Biological basis of cancer as a disruption of differentiation and tissue architecture
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how genetic, epigenetic, and environmental drivers disrupt normal developmental differentiation and multicellular tissue architecture to initiate tumor growth.

topics.label: Invasion, metastasis, and benign versus malignant tumor classification
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the behavioral, histological, and terminological distinctions between benign and malignant tumors across stages of invasion and progression.

topics.label: Cancer morbidity, mortality, and comparative incidence across species
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine the physiological mechanisms causing patient morbidity and mortality alongside cancer occurrence patterns across humans and other multicellular animals.

topics.label: Clinical presentation and organ-specific cancer screening
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics address clinical presentation and the diagnostic utility, histology, and limitations of screening programs across different organ systems.

topics.label: Closing remarks and housekeeping
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture with a summary reminder of the learning outcomes and upcoming practical sessions.
